cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at Rampurhat Medical College (rural) between January 2020 and June 2021 and Medical College, Kolkata (urban) between January 2017 and December 2017.
finding: The rural center had a lower cesarean section rate (35.67%) compared to the urban center (49.55%), with Robson group 5 (previous cesarean birth) being the highest contributor in the urban center and group 2 (multiparous term cephalic singleton pregnancies) in the rural center.
